title: Green Means Spring and Other Things
titleZh: 绿色意味着春天及其他事物

sentences.en: Now, the VOA Learning English program Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 现在，美国之音英语学习节目《词与故事》。

sentences.en: Today we talk about a color found all throughout nature – green!
sentences.zh: 今天我们来聊聊一种在自然界中随处可见的颜色——绿色！

sentences.en: Green is also very common in American English.
sentences.zh: 绿色在美国英语中也非常常见。

sentences.en: Let’s hear Warren Scheer read a story about these colorful expressions!
sentences.zh: 让我们来听沃伦·谢尔朗读一个关于这些生动表达的故事！

sentences.en: Green is an important color in nature.
sentences.zh: 绿色是自然界中一种重要的颜色。

sentences.en: It is the color of grass and the leaves on trees.
sentences.zh: 它是草地和树叶的颜色。

sentences.en: It is also the color of most growing plants.
sentences.zh: 它也是大多数生长中的植物的颜色。

sentences.en: Sometimes, the word green means young, fresh and growing.
sentences.zh: 有时，"green"这个词意味着年轻、新鲜和成长。

sentences.en: Sometimes, it describes something that is not yet ripe or finished.
sentences.zh: 有时，它用来描述尚未成熟或完成的事物。

sentences.en: For example, a greenhorn is someone who has no experience, who is new to a situation.
sentences.zh: 例如，"greenhorn"（新手）指毫无经验、对某种情况陌生的人。

sentences.en: In the fifteenth century, a greenhorn was a young cow or ox whose horns had not yet developed.
sentences.zh: 在15世纪，"greenhorn"指尚未长出角的母牛或小牛。

sentences.en: A century or so later, a greenhorn was a soldier who had not yet had any experience in battle.
sentences.zh: 大约一个世纪后，"greenhorn"指尚未经历过任何实战的士兵。

sentences.en: By the eighteenth century, a greenhorn had the meaning it has today - a person who is new in a job.
sentences.zh: 到了18世纪，"greenhorn"有了今天的含义——指刚从事某项工作的人。

sentences.en: About one hundred years ago, greenhorn was a popular expression in the American west.
sentences.zh: 大约在一百年前，"greenhorn"是美国西部流行的一个说法。

sentences.en: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east.
sentences.zh: 老居民用它来描述刚从东部大城市迁来的人。

sentences.en: The greenhorn lacked the skills he would need to live in the hard, rough country.
sentences.zh: 这些新人缺乏在艰苦、粗犷的边远地区生活所需的技能。

sentences.en: Someone who has the ability to grow plants well is said to have a green thumb.
sentences.zh: 善于种植植物的人被称为拥有"绿手指"。

sentences.en: The expression comes from the early 1900s.
sentences.zh: 这个说法源自20世纪初。

sentences.en: A person with a green thumb seems to have a magic touch that makes plants grow quickly and well.
sentences.zh: 拥有"绿手指"的人似乎拥有一种魔法般的手艺，能让植物长得又快又好。

sentences.en: You might say that the woman next door has a green thumb if her garden continues to grow long after your plants have died.
sentences.zh: 如果你的植物都枯死了，而隔壁女士的花园却依然生机勃勃，你就可以说她有一双"绿手指"。

sentences.en: The Green Revolution is the name given some years ago to the development of new kinds of rice and other grains.
sentences.zh: 绿色革命是几年前人们对新型水稻和其他谷物培育发展的称呼。

sentences.en: The new plants produced much larger crops.
sentences.zh: 这些新植物产出了大得多的农作物。

sentences.en: The Green Revolution was the result of hard work by agricultural scientists who had green thumbs.
sentences.zh: 绿色革命是那些拥有绿色 thumbs 的农业科学家辛勤工作的成果。

sentences.en: Green is also the color used to describe the powerful emotion, jealousy.
sentences.zh: 绿色也是用来描述嫉妒这一强烈情感的颜色。

sentences.en: The green-eyed monster is not a frightening creature from outer space.
sentences.zh: 绿眼怪物并不是来自外太空的可怕生物。

sentences.en: It is an expression used about four hundred years ago by British writer William Shakespeare in his play "Othello."
sentences.zh: 这是英国作家莎士比亚在其戏剧《奥赛罗》中约四百年前使用的一个表达。

sentences.en: It describes the unpleasant feeling a person has when someone has something he wants.
sentences.zh: 它描述了一个人看到别人拥有自己想要之物时的不快感受。

sentences.en: A young man may suffer from the green-eyed monster if his girlfriend begins going out with someone else.
sentences.zh: 如果一个年轻男子的女友开始和别人约会，他可能会受到绿眼怪物的困扰。

sentences.en: Or, that green-eyed monster may affect your friend if you get a pay raise and she does not.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你加薪而你的朋友没有，这个绿眼怪物可能会影响到你的朋友。

sentences.en: In most places in the world, a green light is a sign to move ahead.
sentences.zh: 在世界大多数地方，绿灯是前进的信号。

sentences.en: A green light on a traffic signal means your car can continue on.
sentences.zh: 交通信号灯上的绿灯意味着你的车可以继续前行。

sentences.en: In everyday speech, a green light means approval to continue with a project.
sentences.zh: 在日常用语中，绿灯表示批准继续某项计划。

sentences.en: We want you to know we have a green light to continue this series next week.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你知道，我们已获准下周继续这一系列节目。

sentences.en: And that's all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期“词汇及其故事”的全部内容。

sentences.en: Don't forget to tune in again for another story about American English expressions.
sentences.zh: 别忘了再次收听关于美式英语表达的另一故事。

sentences.en: Until next time!
sentences.zh: 我们下次再见！
